vision: High fidelity context, high utility work, clear human control, lightweight on-demand operation

room.role: Case-scoped shared context and work space
room.implementation: SQLite sources, tasks, definitions, feedback and receipts

board.role: One conversation surface, many workflow frames
board.implementation: Human requests and tool results projected from persisted tasks

work.role: Versioned task, proposal, approval, artifact and capsule
work.implementation: Python zookeeper plus stateless Go worker

llm_room.role: Future proposal-only model adapters share the same case capsule

efficiency.reranker: CPU BM25 plus explicit case/query/source-bound feedback

authority.n1_auth: One local operator effect gate per task; not verified legal identity
authority.0auth: Workers, source text, topology, feedback and future model proposals cannot approve effects
authority.ownerauth: Explicit current-payload approval from the local session
authority.oauth: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; 0auth is not an OAuth authentication claim

realmdoor.role: One loopback API gateway for this package

ikea_scan.role: Observe registered local capabilities and request outcomes
